name: The Arabs
overview: Scripture identifies the Arabs as descendants dwelling from Havilah to Shur, near Egypt and Assyria, situating them geographically and historically within God's unfolding plan (Genesis 25:18). This context reminds believers that God's kingdom transcends earthly boundaries and conflicts, as Jesus teaches that His kingdom is not of this world, emphasizing a spiritual reign beyond ethnic or territorial divisions (John 18:36). Additionally, Isaiah's depiction of the unlearned being called to read highlights the accessibility of God's word to all peoples, including the Arabs, underscoring the universal offer of salvation through Christ (Isaiah 29:12).
